description: Start an invoice. Required: exactly one of lead_id, account_id or contact_id. Optional: lines, title, intro, outro, address, due_days (default 20), payment_note (the IBAN block), currency. The number follows the tenant's own series, RE-<Jahr>-<MONAT>-<n>. Nothing is sent.

intro.description: Introductory text printed above the positions

lines.description: Invoice positions: name, quantity, unit_price and optional fields

outro.description: Closing text printed below the positions

payment_note.description: Payment information block (e.g. IBAN) printed on the invoice

name: draft_invoice
